verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented white-label or embeddable offering that lets a developer expose Trigger.dev's automation experience to their own customers. Self-hosting (control over infrastructure and exposed URLs) and per-user concurrency keys are adjacent deployment and developer building blocks, not a white-label embedding capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
